# REST API reference

The server listens on port **6399** (HTTP/1.1, JSON). Routes under `/v1/` need an `X-Api-Key` header when auth is enabled (the default in the Docker image). Every JSON response has the shape `{"status": "ok", "data": ...}` or `{"status": "error", "error": "...", "code": N}`.

This page is generated from the route registrations in [`include/tidevec/api/rest_server.hpp`](https://github.com/ashishodu2023/TideVec/blob/main/include/tidevec/api/rest_server.hpp). Request fields are the JSON keys the handler reads (with the default it applies); response fields are the keys of the `data` object it returns.

In [cluster mode](../operations/cluster.md) writes must go to the leader: followers answer `421` with the leader URL in the `X-TideVec-Leader` header and the `leader` field.

## Cluster

### `POST /v1/admin/cluster/add_node` {#post-v1-admin-cluster-add-node}

Add a node to the Raft cluster (experimental).

Leader only (421 + leader hint elsewhere). The new node must be
running with --raft-join; it replicates as a learner until caught
up, then a CONFIG entry makes it a voter. One change at a time.

**Auth:** admin API key · **Cluster mode:** leader only

| Request field | Required | Default | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes |  | handler |
| `url` | yes |  | handler |
| `timeout_ms` |  | `30000` | handler |

Response `data` fields: `message`, `id`, `config_index`, `members`

Status codes: `200` OK, `400` Bad request, `401` Missing or bad API key, `403` Not the admin API key (tenant keys), `409` Conflict, `421` Not the Raft leader (cluster mode)

## Model migration (DriftBridge)

### `POST /v1/collections/{name}/drift/start` {#post-v1-collections-name-drift-start}

Start a DriftBridge model migration (standalone servers only).

new_dim is optional and must equal the collection dim.

Starts a zero-downtime model migration on the named collection.
TideVec builds a shadow index in the background while the live
index continues serving queries. The caller supplies a
reembed_url — an HTTP endpoint that accepts:
POST {"id":"v1","payload":{...}} → {"embedding":[...]}
and returns the new-model embedding for each vector.

Returns immediately; poll GET /drift/status for progress.

**Auth:** API key

Example body:

```json
{"reembed_url":"http://...","new_dim":1536,"M":16,
       "ef_construction":200,"temporal":{...}}
```

| Request field | Required | Default | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reembed_url` |  | `""` | handler |
| `M` |  | `16` | handler |
| `ef_construction` |  | `200` | handler |
| `temporal` |  |  | handler |
| `new_dim` |  | `0` | handler |
| `temporal.half_life_ms` |  | server default | `temporal_cfg_from_json` |
| `temporal.temporal_blend` |  | server default | `temporal_cfg_from_json` |
| `temporal.staleness_threshold` |  | server default | `temporal_cfg_from_json` |
| `temporal.temporal_cutoff` |  | server default | `temporal_cfg_from_json` |

Response `data` fields: `message`, `collection`, `total_vectors`, `status_url`

Status codes: `200` OK, `400` Bad request, `401` Missing or bad API key, `403` Forbidden (tenant, quota, or URL not allowed), `404` Collection not found, `501` Not supported in this mode

<small>Source: `rest_server.hpp` line 1447</small>

## Search

### `POST /v1/collections/{name}/search` {#post-v1-collections-name-search}

Vector, keyword or hybrid search with recency and supersession.

**Auth:** API key · **Rate-limited**

Example body:

```json
{
  "vector": [...],
  "top_k": 10,
  "temporal_blend": 0.3,
  "mode": "vector_only"|"causal_expand"|"contradiction_check",
  "filter": "key=value" | {"lang":"en","year":{"$gte":2020}},
  "as_of": 1700000000000 | "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "text": "keyword query",          (BM25; hybrid with "vector")
  "hybrid": {"fusion":"rrf"|"weighted","alpha":0.5,"rrf_k":60},
  "include_trace": false,
  "metric": "cosine"
}
"vector" may be omitted when "text" is given (keyword-only).
```

| Request field | Required | Default | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vector` |  |  | handler |
| `top_k` |  | `10` | `query_opts_from_json` |
| `temporal_blend` |  | collection setting | `query_opts_from_json` |
| `text` |  | `""` | `query_opts_from_json` |
| `hybrid` |  |  | `query_opts_from_json` |
| `metric` |  | `"cosine"` | `query_opts_from_json` |
| `ef_search` |  | `128` | `query_opts_from_json` |
| `include_trace` |  | `false` | `query_opts_from_json` |
| `include_staleness_warnings` |  | `true` | `query_opts_from_json` |
| `superseded_penalty` |  | `0.0` | `query_opts_from_json` |
| `mode` |  | `"vector_only"` | `query_opts_from_json` |
| `causal_hops` |  | `1` | `query_opts_from_json` |
| `hybrid.fusion` |  | `"rrf"` | `hybrid_opts_from_json` |
| `hybrid.alpha` |  | server default | `hybrid_opts_from_json` |
| `hybrid.rrf_k` |  | server default | `hybrid_opts_from_json` |
| `hybrid.prefetch` |  | server default | `hybrid_opts_from_json` |
| `filter` |  |  | `apply_filter_fields` |
| `as_of` |  |  | `apply_filter_fields` |

Response `data` fields: `results`, `count`

Status codes: `200` OK, `400` Bad request, `401` Missing or bad API key, `403` Forbidden (tenant, quota, or URL not allowed), `404` Collection not found, `429` Rate limited, `503` Unavailable / leadership changed

### `POST /v1/collections/{name}/compact` {#post-v1-collections-name-compact}

Body (optional): {"wait":true}.

Rebuilds the vector graph and payload/text indexes without the
tombstones left by deletes and re-embeds. The rebuild runs in the
background (reads and writes continue; writes made meanwhile are
replayed before the swap); "wait":true returns once it is done.
Compaction also starts by itself once tombstones reach
compaction_ratio x live vectors (collection create option).

**Auth:** API key · **Cluster mode:** leader only · **Replicated write** (`compact`)

| Request field | Required | Default | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wait` |  | `false` | handler |

Status codes: `200` OK, `400` Bad request, `401` Missing or bad API key, `403` Forbidden (tenant, quota, or URL not allowed), `404` Collection not found, `421` Not the Raft leader (cluster mode), `503` Write not confirmed (cluster mode)
